jobs.prompt: The full suite on this branch has failures caused by the second review round (commits since f82188e): tests/board-inbox.test.mjs (the board serves it read-only behind the token: inbox counts 2 and 5 where 0 and 0 are expected; and feedback 5: test and temp projects are left out by default), tests/forget.test.mjs (forget --missing and --scratch bulk limits and --yes), tests/kit-and-interview.test.mjs (swarm init --kit end to end, and the kit flag given twice test shows an unexpected .project-swarm entry), and tests/update-pending-round2.test.mjs (check whether it is flaky or fails under the full suite: run it 3 times, and fix any timing dependency with injected clocks). For each, run it alone (node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test FILE), read the failure and decide: if the round-two behavior change is intended (explicit forOwner option instead of stack sniffing so callers that do not pass it do not prune or filter; strict scratch rule for forget --scratch and the inbox; registry prune only on ENOENT with readable parent; never prune under /Volumes, /mnt, /media) update the test to pass the new explicit option or expectation with a comment, never weakening a safety assertion; if it exposes a real regression (the board server or init no longer passes forOwner, init now registers or writes a .project-swarm entry it did not before, forget loses a limit) fix the code. Check specifically that the real board server paths (tools/watch-cli.mjs, tools/watch-server.mjs, tools/phone.mjs, tools/inbox.mjs) pass forOwner true, so the real board still hides scratch projects and counts only real inbox items. Run all four test files at the end and the other tests that import tools/projects.mjs, tools/scratch-roots.mjs or tools/board-inbox.mjs. IMPORTANT: no URL with credentials in it (user:password@host) and no token-shaped literal may appear in any file: where a test needs a credentialed URL or secret-looking value, assemble it at runtime from parts (for example ['user', 'pw'].join) so the secret scan finds nothing. ignoreTests reason: the named test files are the context.
